text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Sheesh... Did I really sleep that long?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've still got time before training... but
I've gotta
make sure I stay awake.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just the same old places over and over,
and
nobody's around to challenge... This
is so boring.

text_block_list.name: Gossipy Passenger
text_block_list.text:
Get this! I heard there's this daredevil
challenge
spot near the next stop. Some
of the things they
do are really
dangerous too...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trying that before heading back will put
me in a
good mood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Frustrated with the long commute,
Nakayama
Festa ends up skipping
training...
